name: train-with-rohin
description: Coaching app for personal trainers and their clients, with a Power BI analytics layer

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,app -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix mobile"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db && sleep 5 && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix mobile
